extracted.intended_audience: researchers, academic partners, civic institutions, early-career ML researchers, and organizations interested in collaborating with Cohere Labs
extracted.subtask_description: An overview page describing Cohere Labs' mission, open-science initiatives, grant and scholar programs, model releases (e.g., Tiny Aya), community resources, and opportunities for collaboration and engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cohere Labs mission
rubrics_metrics.description: Changing where, how, and by whom breakthroughs happen. Cohere Labs pushes the boundaries of fundamental ML research while changing who shapes it, bringing diverse perspectives together to build trustworthy, collaborative, and universally capable AI systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize diverse perspectives and collaboration in research; emphasize trustworthiness and broad capability when designing and evaluating projects associated with the Lab.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open Science Initiative (release and community)
rubrics_metrics.description: Through nurturing a vibrant Open Science Community with 4500 members from 150 countries and releasing all of our research and models to the public, we are empowering the next era of scientific discovery and progress.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research and models are expected to be released publicly; community-building and open dissemination are core principles. Engagement with a global community and contributions that are shareable/public-facing align with this initiative.

rubrics_metrics.name: Catalyst Grants (purpose and intended recipients)
rubrics_metrics.description: Catalyst Grants provide academic partners, civic institutions and impact focused organizations free access to the Cohere API to pursue projects driving real-world change through artificial intelligence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grants target academic, civic, and impact-oriented organizations; successful projects should aim for demonstrable real-world impact and make use of Cohere API access. The program offers free infrastructure/API access as the core support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Scholars Program (mentorship and infrastructure access)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Scholars Program carves pathways for rising researchers to become the next generation of AI leaders through mentorship with our top-tier research team and access to powerful research infrastructure.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program participation centers on mentorship, professional development, and access to research compute/infrastructure; designed for early-career researchers seeking guided research experience and career pathway support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Tiny Aya model family (model goals and attributes)
rubrics_metrics.description: Experience the Tiny Aya model family: 70+ languages, region-tuned expertise, and phone-ready performance that brings high-quality multilingual capabilities to every corner of the globe.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Model evaluation/demo emphasis is on broad multilingual coverage, regionally tuned knowledge, and resource-efficiency suitable for phones; tradeoffs between scale, multilingual depth, and efficiency are highlighted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open Science Community participation and cost policy
rubrics_metrics.description: We do not charge for participating in any of our programs, and are committed to supporting educational outreach programs, which include compute resources and infrastructure needed to participate in machine learning research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programs and community membership are free; prospective participants can expect supported access to compute and infrastructure as part of educational/outreach commitments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research dissemination and public engagement channels
rubrics_metrics.description: Research outputs are published (papers, featured models) and made interactable via resources like the Cohere Labs Hugging Face Space; events and talks are organized to engage the community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes making research discoverable and usable: publish papers, release models, provide interactive demos/spaces, and run public-facing events to foster engagement and reproducibility.
